text:
Ana G.: Hey team — opened a docs PR that updates the v2 migration guide and adds a new Rust SDK snippet. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4122. Can someone own review+approve so we can merge during tomorrow's 3pm PT merge window?
Jordan P.: I can look at the migration guide content (API surface changes) but I don't feel confident reviewing Rust snippets.
Sam K.: I can take the Rust snippet, but I'm on on-call until ~2pm PT. If it's after that I can do a quick pass. Any failing CI on the PR?
Ana G.: Thanks — the docs preview build is flaking sporadically. Locally the preview fails on the big fenced code block with the new example. Error in the build: `Error: markdown renderer hit recursion limit rendering fenced code -> snippet includes long inline comments`. I trimmed some comments but the preview still hangs sometimes.
docs-bot: docs-preview build #78 failed on commit a1b2c3 — see https://ci.internal/redwood/docs/78 and logs: `renderer: fatal: nested code block size exceeded`.
Lee M.: Oof. Two options: split the PR into (A) migration guide text and (B) SDK snippet file; or keep together but move the long snippet to a gist and embed a short inline example. Splitting makes CI smaller and quicker to preview.
Jordan P.: Splitting sounds safest to speed approvals. The migration guide needs my signoff; I won't hold the snippet review up if Sam can approve separately.
Ana G.: I prefer to keep them linked in one PR because the migration guide cross-references exact lines in the snippet. If we split I can add explicit versioned links, but that takes extra churn. Open to whichever gets it merged faster.
Sam K.: If you'd split, I can review the snippet around 2:15pm PT. If you keep them together, I can still review but might miss the 3pm merge window.
Ana G.: OK — plan: I'll open a tiny follow-up PR with the code examples extracted to a new file and leave the migration text in the original. That should make previews lighter. Also I'll move the largest comment blocks behind a `<!-- large-comment: gist -->` placeholder for now.
Lee M.: Sounds good. Quick checklist: 1) split snippet into `guides/migration/v2-rust-snippet.md` 2) run `make docs-preview` locally to confirm render 3) @Jordan review the migration guide text 4) @Sam review the rust snippet 5) ping me for final go/no-go before 3pm PT.
Ana G.: I'm on it. Will push the split PR in ~20m and tag reviewers.
Jordan P.: Will review migration guide once PR is up. If I see any ambiguous wording I'll suggest specific replacement lines.
Sam K.: Taking notes — please @mention me on the snippet PR and include a short git diff in the thread so I can triage quickly on mobile if needed.
Ana G.: Will do. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Lee M.: LGTM — and if the docs-preview still fails after the split, we can temporarily land the migration guide with a note and follow up the snippet as a post-merge docs patch.
Ana G.: Noted. I'll follow the split + local preview route first. If anyone is free in 30m for a quick sync I'll be at my calendar-less slot.
Jordan P.: Free in 45m — otherwise I'll catch it after lunch.
Sam K.: I should be free right after on-call handoff at 2:05pm PT.
Ana G.: Great, thanks everyone. I'll post the new PR IDs here when ready.
